title: VHDX (Virtual Hard Disk v2) signature
summary: A VHDX file begins with the 8-byte signature 'vhdxfile' (0x76 0x68 0x64 0x78 0x66 0x69 0x6C 0x65) at offset 0.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: VHDX supports up to 64TB (vs VHD's 2TB limit).
VHDX supports 4KB logical sector sizes and larger block sizes.
VHDX is the default format for Hyper-V on Windows 8+.
